text: Menen, ko Menen woni heddotooɓe ɓen ɓaawo re'ugol tagoore nden, Men rona leydi ndin, Men ronira kadi ɓen wonuɓe e hoore mayri re'ugol ɓe e heddagol Amen ɓaawo maɓɓe, e Jeyal Amen e maɓɓe, e firlitorgol Amen e maɓɓe no Men Yiɗiri, ko ka Amen Menen Tun ɓe ruttoytee Ñalnde Darngal fii Hasboore e Njoɓdi.
